edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The proposed purchase price for the Shares is USD 45,000,000, subject to mutually agreed cash, debt and working-capital adjustments. The definitions, accounting policies, target working capital, calculation procedures and dispute-resolution mechanism for those adjustments remain to be agreed. The Buyer's USD 36,000,000 counterproposal has not been accepted. Any definitive transaction remains subject to completion of satisfactory due diligence before signing and mutual agreement on definitive terms.

2. Closing. The parties shall target Closing within 30 days after signing the definitive agreement, subject to satisfaction or, where legally permissible, waiver by the party entitled to the benefit of the applicable closing conditions. Those conditions shall include required regulatory and corporate approvals, agreed material third-party consents, accuracy of the parties' representations at Closing subject to agreed qualifications, and material performance of applicable pre-closing covenants. The definitive agreement shall specify the conditions, reasonable cooperation obligations, an outside date and termination rights; the 30-day target shall not require Closing while any applicable condition remains unsatisfied and unwaived.

3. Representations and Liability Protections. The definitive agreement shall contain customary Seller representations concerning title to the Shares, authority, capitalization, financial statements, taxes, material contracts, litigation, compliance with applicable law and undisclosed liabilities, subject to agreed scope, materiality and knowledge qualifications and appropriate disclosure schedules. It shall also contain customary Buyer representations concerning authority and ability to fund the purchase price, together with mutually agreed pre-closing covenants. Indemnification provisions, survival periods, claim procedures, caps, baskets, exclusions, exclusive-remedy provisions and an escrow or holdback shall be negotiated. The amount, duration, funding and release mechanics of any escrow or holdback remain open; this draft does not establish unlimited liability or an agreed retention amount.

4. Confidentiality. The definitive agreement shall require the parties to keep its terms and nonpublic transaction information confidential and to use such information solely for evaluating, financing and implementing the transaction. Permitted disclosures shall include disclosures on a need-to-know basis to professional advisers and actual or prospective financing sources who are subject to professional confidentiality duties or confidentiality obligations appropriate to the information disclosed. Each party shall be responsible for breaches by its recipients to the extent agreed in the definitive agreement. Disclosures required by law, regulation or legal process shall be permitted, with advance notice to the other party where legally permissible, reasonable cooperation in seeking protective treatment and disclosure limited to what is legally required. Any existing confidentiality agreement remains in effect according to its terms. Diligence access shall be subject to agreed confidentiality, privilege, data-protection and competitively sensitive information safeguards.

receiver.message_back:
Dear Counsel,

Thank you for the revised draft. We acknowledge that Seller has not accepted USD 36,000,000. Buyer likewise does not accept USD 45,000,000 and maintains its USD 36,000,000 proposal, subject to satisfactory diligence, agreement on adjustments and protections, and execution of definitive documentation. Please confirm whether Seller will proceed on that pricing basis or provide a substantive counterproposal.

We welcome the conditional closing timetable and expanded framework. To move beyond placeholders, we propose:

• Pricing on an agreed cash-free, debt-free basis with normalized working capital. We should settle the equity-price bridge, cash and debt-like items, transaction expenses, working-capital peg and accounting hierarchy, with no double counting and an independent-accountant mechanism for disputed completion accounts.
• A 10% escrow for 18 months; general representation survival of 18 months; a 15% general indemnity cap; and a 0.5% deductible basket, each percentage measured against the final purchase price. Fundamental representations, taxes, fraud and specifically identified risks require separate treatment. Timely asserted unresolved claims must remain protected. These are Buyer proposals, not agreed terms.
• Additional representations covering assets, IP, employment and benefits, privacy and cybersecurity, environmental matters and related-party dealings, together with ordinary-course covenants and restrictions on distributions and other value leakage.
• Retention of the conditional 30-day closing target, with a proposed 90-day outside date and appropriate termination rights, without requiring either party to close while its applicable conditions remain unsatisfied and unwaived.

Our initial diligence request comprises: corporate records and capitalization; three years of financial statements and current management accounts; cash, debt, debt-like obligations and monthly working-capital detail; tax returns and audits; material customer, supplier and financing contracts; change-of-control provisions; litigation and regulatory matters; employee and benefit arrangements; IP ownership and licences; privacy and cybersecurity records; material assets, environmental matters and insurance; related-party arrangements; and proposed disclosure schedules.

Please establish a secure, access-controlled data room and nominate finance, legal and operational contacts for coordinated Q&A and management sessions. Access should be subject to the existing confidentiality agreement and agreed protocols, including redaction of unnecessary personal data, withholding privileged material and clean-team arrangements where competitively sensitive information warrants them. We will not contact employees, customers or suppliers without agreed authorization. Please identify any material categories withheld and the applicable reason without disclosing privileged substance.

All proposals remain nonbinding and subject to Buyer approval and executed definitive documentation. Existing confidentiality obligations remain unaffected.

Kind regards,
Bellweather Croft LLP
Counsel for the Buyer
